rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for playful behaviour intended to annoy or cause minor trouble, especially a prank.

example.english: Those kids are always up to mischief, keeping everyone in the house awake.
example.traditional: 班細路成日搞惡作劇，搞到成屋人都瞓唔着。
